title: Beti
desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.

title: Kirayadar
desc: Laxmi Abhyankar and her employed daughter Jaya live on rent in a flat on Pali Hill, Mumbai they rented years ago from Lucknow-based Kundanlal Choudhury. His son Anil comes to Mumbai and gets a job.

title: Mazdoor
desc: Dinanath is a foreman in a textile mill who dreams of one day running his own mill more fairly. He leaves the mill after upsetting the management by supporting his mistreated co-workers. With the support and inspiration of a young orphan, Ashok, he has taken in, Dinanath raises the money to buy a property, leading to the eventual realization of his dream. Then Smita enters the picture and everything starts to go wrong.

title: Bad Aur Badnaam
desc: Story begins with three villains getting a lot of money and new identities from rich man Pedro getting killed in return. Later two secret agents - James (Sanjeev Kumar) from Ringania and Ashwinikumar (Shatrughan Sinha) from Indian intelligence Bureau are shown at the top of their game. Due to some misconception, they brcome sworn enemies but meanwhile they have their jobs to do. Ashwinikumar is investigating a mysteriousplot to kill a VVIP in Delhi while James is no a Ringanian mission in india. They fight and temporarity make Peace and the rest of the movie is about their joint effort to figure out the mystery and ruin the evil plot.
